query:
SELECT 
  JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')) as lhpType,
  JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')) as lhpLen,
  LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), 200) as lhpPreview
FROM analysis_reports WHERE clientId = 870001 ORDER BY generatedAt DESC LIMIT 1
